hero.h1: Agentic Document Knowledge, Workflow, and Compliance Automation Solution

cta.text: CONTACT US TO AUTOMATE DOCUMENT CONTROL

client.name: Petrochemical Company
description: The client is a leading Saudi Arabian petrochemical company that operates one of the largest integrated refining and petrochemical complexes in the Middle East. It produces a wide range of refined hydrocarbons and petrochemical products used globally across plastics, fuels, packaging, detergents, automotive components, and more.

outcomes.heading: Quantified Business Outcomes

stats.label: Fewer
stats.desc: avoidable document rework and rejection cycles

areas: Document search, retrieval, and navigation time
Workflow status queries and report preparation
Document preparation cycle time, first-time compliance, and rework rate

paragraphs: The company manages its approved policies, procedures, charters, manuals, and standard operating procedures through an electronic document management system built on Power Apps and SharePoint sites, lists, and document libraries. The system holds more than 4,000 controlled documents spread across complex libraries and nested organizational structures.

Finding the right document meant knowing its exact file name, document identifier, department, or function. Users often remembered what a document was about, but not what it was called or where it lived.
bullets: Keyword-based search was slow and depended on exact information.
When search failed, users had to navigate nested document structures manually.
There was no simple way to ask for a document using natural language.
Checking workflow progress, approval status, and assigned items meant moving between different areas of the system.
Reports on due, overdue, pending, and expired documents required extra manual effort.

paragraphs: Document creation added a second layer of friction. The company enforces strict templates and filling guidelines for each document category, but these were documented in a user manual that users did not always read or follow consistently.
bullets: Documents were submitted with incorrect fonts, sizes, margins, tables, sections, or images.
Users frequently downloaded existing templates and copied content from older revisions.
Copying and pasting damaged template structure and removed or corrupted Word content controls.
Non-compliant documents were rejected and returned, and repeated corrections increased preparation and approval time.

needs.heading: What The Company Needed
needs.intro: The company aimed to implement an intelligent, guided solution that could:

items.text: Enable natural language discovery across thousands of approved documents
Provide instant visibility into document workflow, approval status, and assigned items
Automate reporting for due, overdue, pending, and expired documents
Guide users through document creation without manual template formatting
Validate documents against compliance rules before submission

solution.heading: Folio3 Solution
solution.intro: Folio3 delivered an AI-powered, SharePoint-grounded document knowledge and workflow agent, combined with a custom document generation and compliance validation platform on Microsoft Azure.

groups.heading: 1. Intelligent Document Agent (Microsoft Copilot Studio)
groups.intro: A multi-agent orchestrated solution where a parent agent acts as the primary conversational assistant, triage agent, and router for specialized tasks. SharePoint serves as the knowledge source and system of record for approved documents. Agentic RAG runs under the hood through Copilot Studio's built-in ingestion and vectorization pipelines. Users reach the agent through a direct 1:1 chat in Microsoft Teams, or through Copilot Chat embedded in the existing Power Apps application. Answers are strictly grounded in the company's document libraries, with citations to the approved sources.

items.label: Copilot Studio
items.text: Parent agent handles conversation, triage, and routing.

items.label: Agentic RAG
items.text: Agentic RAG with vector and semantic search finds documents by meaning and context.

items.label: WorkIQ
items.text: WorkIQ (formerly Tenant Graph Grounding) improves SharePoint retrieval quality and organizational context.

items.label: Copilot Studio
items.text: Workflow Tracker Agent (child agent) answers document status, approval progress, and assigned item queries.

items.label: Excel
items.text: Report Generation Agent (child agent) exports due, overdue, pending, and expired document reports to Excel.

groups.heading: 2. Document Generation and Compliance Platform (Microsoft Azure)
groups.intro: A guided editor backed by two serverless Azure Functions endpoints. The Generation Service takes structured HTML content from the editor, converts it into Word XML, and inserts it into the correct sections of the selected template. The Validation Service checks the finished document against compliance rules and returns the exact issues users must fix before starting the approval process.

steps.title: Natural Language Document Search

groups.label: Users ask the agent for:
bullets: Policies, procedures, charters, manuals, or SOPs in plain language
Documents by context or purpose, without exact names, IDs, departments, or locations

groups.label: The agent:
bullets: Searches SharePoint knowledge sources using Agentic RAG with vector and semantic search
Uses WorkIQ to improve retrieval quality and organizational context
Returns grounded answers with citations and links to the source documents

steps.value: Faster discovery across 4,000+ documents with no dependency on exact file names or folder structures.

steps.title: Workflow Status and Assigned Items

groups.label: The parent agent routes workflow queries to the Workflow Tracker Agent, which answers:
bullets: Where a document sits in the approval process
Which stages it has completed and whether it is approved
Which documents are currently assigned to the user

steps.value: Instant visibility into document ownership and approval progress, read directly from the SharePoint lists behind the existing workflow.

steps.title: On-Demand Document Reports

groups.label: The Report Generation Agent:
bullets: Generates reports for due, overdue, pending, and expired documents
Exports results directly to Excel

steps.value: Faster operational reporting with minimal manual data collection.

steps.title: Guided Document Creation

groups.label: Users:
bullets: Select a document category such as policy, procedure, charter, manual, or SOP
Follow the correct structure, loaded section by section
Add paragraphs, headings, bullets, and images through a drag-and-drop editor

steps.value: Users focus on content, not formatting, and no longer need to memorize template guidelines.

steps.title: Compliant Word Document Generation

groups.label: The Azure Functions Generation Service:
bullets: Converts structured editor content into Word XML
Inserts it into the correct sections of the approved template
Preserves template structure and protects Word content controls

steps.value: Standardized documents with less manual formatting and lower risk of template corruption.

steps.title: Pre-Submission Compliance Validation

groups.label: Before upload, the Validation Service checks:
bullets: Font styles and sizes
Page margins
Required sections and template structure
Completed tables
Required images (when applicable)
Word content controls
File size limits

steps.value: Compliance issues are caught early, so documents enter the existing approval process submission-ready.

impact.heading: Impact & Outcomes
impact.intro: The combination of a Copilot Studio multi-agent assistant and Azure-powered document validation transformed the company's document management system from manual navigation and template preparation into an intelligent, conversational, guided, and compliant experience, accessible through Microsoft Teams and the existing Power Apps application.
bullets: 60% – 80% reduction in document search time by replacing manual navigation of complex SharePoint hierarchies with natural language search
50% – 70% faster access to workflow information on document status, completed approval stages, pending actions, and assigned items
70% – 90% reduction in report preparation effort through on-demand Excel reports for due, overdue, pending, and expired documents
30% – 50% reduction in document preparation time through guided, section-based content entry and automated template population
40% – 60% fewer avoidable rework and rejection cycles by validating formatting, sections, tables, images, and content controls before initiation
2x – 3x faster creation of submission-ready documents by eliminating manual formatting, copy-pasting, and guideline checking
100% of documents processed through the platform checked against the same defined compliance rules before upload
4,000+ approved documents accessible through natural language, with existing initiation governance and approval processes fully preserved
impact.footnote: Outcomes are estimated based on the manual process steps replaced or automated by the solution.
